elements.quote: A captain without a ship is just a man with a hat.

elements.p: The shipwright's drafting table stands at the far end of the grand pier. Choose a hull from the ledger, pay in doubloons, and she is built straight onto the water. A small cutter costs 25 doubloons, a flagship 260.
Bigger hulls go on sale as you open the outer seas. Each captain may own one ship, so scuttle the old one before you buy another.
Every flag on the water sails four hulls: a small one for the home seas, two middling ones, and a flagship for the deep. You'll meet them all at sea, and you can commission most of them yourself.

elements.row: Corsairs: the Bilge Rat, the xebec, the Blackheart brig, the Dread Galleon
Emerald Co.: the Herring Lass, the merchantman, the Silver Herring, the Emerald Empress
Armada: HMS Swift, HMS Vigilant, the frigate, HMS Sovereign
Drowned Fleet: the wraith, the bone galley, the drowned hulk, the Phantom Galleon

elements.quote: The Sovereign carries two decks of guns. If you see her topsails, think hard before you hold your course.

elements.p: Bring your ship within reach of the shipwright and pay in materials to improve her.

elements.row: Hull Reinforcement - more hull to lose
Cannon Mounts - room for more guns
Speed Rigging - she sails as if she had another mast
Armour Plating - shot does less harm

elements.p: Load one cannon and the crew loads every empty gun on that side of the deck. With the second refit they load the whole broadside, on every deck.
Lets you build onto your ship, even under sail: a few blocks at first, up to sixty-four.
An iron-shod keel. She ploughs a channel through sand, coral and silt; with the second refit, through rock as well. It won't take you over dry land.
The shipwright will repaint your ship in a new set of colours. The hull, deck, trim, bands and sails all change; the guns, masts and helm stay as they are.

elements.row: Faction colours - once a flag counts you a friend
A dozen bought liveries - Royal Regalia, Jade Dragon...

elements.p: Some colours can't be bought. Each of the great beasts leaves a livery behind when it dies. Kill twenty sharks for the Great White, and keep eight kinds of parrot for the Parrot Plumage.
Once you own a livery you keep it, and switching to it costs only a small fee. She can always go back to her own colours.
A Mooring Post holds any ship within 12 blocks and slowly patches her hull, and twice as fast in your own hideout.
Wavebreak's harbour asks for a permit: about a tenth of what your hull cost, for three days. Your first visit is free.
Ships stay alive out to the edge of sight, so you can watch a rival come over the horizon and a crippled merchantman crawl into port.

elements.row: A Ship Repair Kit patches a hull at sea
A ship's cat brings luck to her captain
A parrot on your shoulder keeps lookout
